sourceFormFields.mailSinceHelp: Leave empty to read mail of any age.
sourceFormFields.descriptionPlaceholder: Brief description of this data source
sourceFormFields.mongoHostHint: A host name, or a mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// connection string (for Atlas). Keep the username and password in their own fields.
sourceFormFields.readInPlace: In place, from Unity Catalog (Iceberg and UniForm tables only)
sourceFormFields.readInPlaceHelp: Each query reads the table's current snapshot through Unity Catalog. A table that is not native Iceberg or UniForm fails, and Unity Catalog must vend storage credentials for it.
sourceFormFields.icebergCatalogTypeHelp: Read when a SingleStore store lands this table by pipeline (a workspace with enable_iceberg_ingest).
sourceFormFields.icebergCatalogPasswordExposure: SingleStore keeps this catalog password in the pipeline's CONFIG, which it does not redact: while a build's pipeline exists, the password can be read in its pipeline metadata.
sourceFormFields.uploadNeedsId: Enter the source's ID first: the file is kept under it.
sourceFormFields.uploadedFileHint: This source's uploaded file, kept in your organization's folder. Upload a new one to replace it.
sourceFormFields.fileLocationsHint: {files}/… in the organization's files, a path on the server, an https:// address, or s3://, gs:// or az:// with the store's credentials; or upload the file.
sourceFormFields.fileDatabaseLocationsHint: {files}/… in the organization's files, a path on the server, an https:// address, or s3://, gs:// or az:// with the store's credentials (read-only there); or upload the file.
sourceFormFields.downloadFromHint: One file, by its path on this server under a directory the operator allows, an https:// address, or s3:// with the store's credentials. A copy is kept in your organization's folder and fetched again as the source's cache TTL lapses.
sourceFormFields.downloadFromHintRemote: One file, by an https:// address or s3:// with the store's credentials. A copy is kept in your organization's folder and fetched again as the source's cache TTL lapses.
sourceFormFields.draftTable: Set up its table now, as a draft
sourceFormFields.draftTableHint: Named and typed from the file as Register Table would propose it, and out of service until a steward takes it out of draft.
